title: Luxor Temple
visualBrief: Luxor principal exterior from ordinary pictures and standard PMTiles: distinct entrance wings, surviving obelisk, open courts, seven-pair colonnade, rear ranges, selected shrines and the independently mapped Abu el-Haggag mosque exterior. Fine reliefs, statue carving, hidden historic interiors and surveyed floors are omitted.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Q319841/way1079039494 identifies the archaeological area only. Standard PMTiles multipart building52776574920845 defines the temple ranges and parallel colonnade strips;35185602195324 independently fixes Serapis. mosqueExterior.basis: Mapped footprint; raised white body, dome, tall white minaret and older tapered stone minaret from the inspected ordinary exterior photographs. All architectural heights and internal positions are estimates. The separate New Mosque minaret in the background is excluded.

reconstruction.rearSurvivalBasis: Mapped rear outline retained as surviving boundary wall bands, with open axial doorways, selected side partitions and partial roofs. Interior wall inventory and roof survival are medium-fi approximations; no solid reconstruction roof over the rear ruins.

geographicProposal.notes: Q319841/way1079039494 identifies the archaeological area only. Standard PMTiles multipart building52776574920845 defines the temple ranges and parallel colonnade strips;35185602195324 independently fixes Serapis. Named obelisk,Tripartite Shrine and Tetrastyl points fix their approximate centers. Native+X follows the mapped colonnade southwest,not the broader undirected archaeological rectangle. Reviewed approximate fit to retained unmodified standard 161-square/6m DEM: piecewise graded court floors, seven occupied ground pockets, detailed joins nearby and coarse skyline joins. All four levels retain covered floors. Full-site renders retain 281 independent map buildings and unchanged native water. Heights and excavation edges are estimates. Native fragments of 33.6374m² and 0.1917m² remain where masks protect independent mapped overlaps; no whole duplicate temple or mosque. Partial-residency clipping is tested separately and does not establish contact outside the resident domain.

groundCutout.basis: Seven courtyard/shrine/pedestal floors are present in every level. The raised mosque foundation is outside these terrain openings. Approximate graded floors and foundation/excavation joins meet the retained standard DEM.

buildingCutout.basis: Only the three independently mapped temple,Serapis and Abu el-Haggag mosque controls are replaced by their authored exterior geometry. A3cm edge allowance is trimmed around every other retained building with a2mm numerical guard. Independent neighbors and courtyard holes are preserved.
